**Turn our existing client base into our biggest growth engine, and kick-start your career in account-based sales!

**As a fulltime Account Development Representative at Relesys, you will play a pivotal role in unlocking the growth potential within our existing client portfolio. Where the Business Development team focuses on opening new doors, you focus on going deeper - identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities across our already strong client relationships with brands like Salling Group, COOP, Carlsberg, Vestas, Specsavers, Joe & the Juice, and many more.

In this role, you will work closely alongside our Account Manager and Client Success Managers, reporting to the Director of Sales based in Copenhagen. Together you will map white space, spot expansion signals, and book qualified meetings for our Account Managers and CSMs to take forward. It is a unique position at the intersection of sales and client relationships - and a powerful stepping stone towards becoming an Account Manager, Account Executive, or Client Success Manager 🚀

This is an exciting and transformative time to join Relesys. In strategic partnership with Private Equity fund Copilot Capital, the coming years will bring extensive growth and opportunities along the way. You'll get a unique chance to make a tremendous impact - not just on new business, but on the clients who are already trusting us to power their frontline workforce every single day.

**What You'll Be Doing

**

• Account-Based Outreach Generate qualified upsell and cross-sell pipeline, and execute structured, targeted outreach to contacts within existing client accounts - across cold calling, email, and LinkedIn. Engage new stakeholders, reactivate dormant contacts, and expand your footprint within each account.

• Expansion Opportunity Identification Map organizational white space and work with internal data and client insights to spot signals of growth potential - new departments, new markets, leadership changes, or product gaps - and translate these into qualified conversations.

• Pipeline Qualification & Meeting Booking Understand the current state of each client relationship, map out decision-makers and influencers, qualify expansion opportunities, and book meetings directly with the relevant Account Manager or CSM - handing off with context and confidence.

• Sales & CS Collaboration Partner with Business Development Consultants, Account Managers, and Client Success Managers to align on account health, priorities, and timing. Share insights from outreach to sharpen targeting and messaging.

• Market & Product Knowledge Become an expert with the Relesys solutions, our value proposition, and how different modules and use cases apply across industries. Stay current on trends in retail & hospitality, and connect it to our product releases and roadmap to articulate ROI to existing clients.

• Sales Discipline Own your activity metrics, pipeline targets, and weekly sales rhythm. Continuously improve outreach quality, conversion rates, and stakeholder mapping.

We invest heavily in training, coaching, and structured development to help you grow.

**Who are you?

**

• 6+ months of experience in outbound sales development, account development, or a client-facing commercial role - B2B SaaS experience is a strong advantage

• Comfortable with proactive outreach including cold calling, and building relationships in an account-based context - you know how to add value from the first conversation

• Strong desire to understand clients deeply: their business, their challenges, and where Relesys can help them grow

• Outstanding communication skills across phone, email, and LinkedIn - you engage stakeholders at multiple levels with confidence and clarity

• Thrive in a fast-paced with a target-driven environment and manage multiple priorities

• Experience from or genuine interest in the retail, hospitality, or frontline workforce industries is a plus - especially if you've worked as a frontline employee yourself

• Experience with MEDDPICC or Command of the Message is an advantage

• Preferred qualifications include a bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field

• Fluent in English, both spoken and written 🇬🇧 and one of the Scandinavian languages.

• Based in or near Copenhagen

**What do we offer?

**

• "Once in a lifetime" growth opportunity in an aspiring unicorn business that will 5x over the coming 4-5 years backed by the Private Equity fund, Copilot Capital

• Career path towards becoming specialist within your field, Account Executive, Account Manager or similar

• Occasional travels to Relesys global offices in line with onboarding, QBRs, Company events etc.

• A collaborative and thriving office-first culture where team spirit and fun are at the heart of everything we do

• Delicious lunch scheme with cake every Thursday

• Homemade buns every Wednesday made by our lovely Piccoline

• Free barista coffee, tea, and a fridge filled with soda

• Massage sessions every second Monday

• Our stylish Nordhavn office, just 100 meters from Orientkaj Metro, offers easy access to public transport and stunning ocean views

• Thriving Culture Club that plans Friday bars, running club, Tuesday fitness w. professional instructor, Wednesday bathing club, Summer parties, Christmas Parties and many other social events!

**When and where do you start?

**We are looking for a colleague to start **in November - December 2026!

**We are welcoming applications from candidates based **in or near Copenhagen.

**Apply for the position by sending your CV through the Apply button.

**We can't wait to hear from you!

****Who are we?

**Relesys isn't just another SaaS company; we are a dynamic force revolutionizing communication and performance management platforms. Established in 2014, we set out on a mission to bridge the gap between HQ and non-desk workers, fostering a thriving workforce.

What value do we bring? People are the heartbeat of our client's business. When employees are thriving and successful, businesses flourish and retention rates increase. Relesys enables our clients to achieve this through an all-in-one app that streamlines communications, training, and daily operations into their own customized and ever-evolving app 📱

With clients such as Salling Group, COOP, Carlsberg, and Vestas - to name just a few - Relesys serves clients in 15 different countries, supporting them in 40 languages with +500,000 licenses across 20,000 stores and users in +100 countries. We have a strong presence in the Nordics and EMEA, and we continue to increasingly attract clients from across the globe, as we are breaking into new, dynamic markets.

At Relesys, we're shaping the future for frontline workers across various industries: Retail, Hospitality, Production/Manufacturing, and Transportation – while having FUN, as our rule number one! Join us on this thrilling journey as we grow and venture into new horizons.

**Our Culture

**Building a world-class organization and culture is our highest priority. We believe in the talent of our people and in long-term collaborations where we value an informal yet highly professional culture. We always go 'the extra mile' for our colleagues and clients, but rule number one - Have fun! This rule is always at the forefront of our minds when we come to work, creating an environment that is filled with passion, energy, and inspiration. We are eager to see what exciting contributions you, as our new colleague, will bring, as we believe that each and every individual has a tremendous influence on the whole 🌍

**Our Tech Stack: https://stackshare.io/companies/sedna

**About Sedna:

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising the operating system for shipping. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming the shipping industry .

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

**About the role

**This role focuses on contributing to the design, development, and evolution of Sedna’s VMS (Voyage Management System). It's a mature, highly specialised platform that shipowners, operators and charterers use to run chartering, voyage operations, cargo and freight/hire invoicing.

VMS has a Java backend exposing a REST API used by our own web client (React) and directly by customers' integrations. Data lives in Oracle, including a significant amount of business logic in PL/SQL. It runs on AWS and builds through GitLab CI/CD.

Sedna VMS is in use 24/7 by shipping companies worldwide. Customers run their daily operations and invoicing on it, so correctness, performance and reliability directly affect their business.

You will play a key part in raising standards and delivering new features. You'll take real ownership of features and of how they behave in production, on a product customers run their business on, and help shape how the platform evolves. You'll work with modern AI-assisted development tools as part of everyday engineering.

**How you’ll make an impact

****Engineering and feature development

**This role contributes to both backend and frontend development. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding requirements, shaping technical approaches, writing code, and contributing to automated tests. Development work spans a mix of new features, improvements, and maintenance, driven by both customer and product needs.

**System architecture and modernisation

**The role includes participating in ongoing efforts to refine and modernise the platform. This involves contributing to technical upgrade work, improving system structure, and supporting longer-term architectural direction as the product grows. Opportunities exist to participate in design discussions and help shape solutions that improve system performance, reliability, and extensibility.

**Quality, testing, and delivery practices

**The team maintains a focus on software quality. We combine unit tests, API regression tests (Postman) and UI tests (Playwright) with peer code review on every merge request. Releases are built and tested through GitLab CI/CD. We're actively improving here: getting more of our test suites running automatically in CI and making them reliable. Engineers who want to drive that, will have room to do it.

**Collaboration with product and customer-facing teams

**The role involves close collaboration with product managers through refinement, planning, and solution discussions. Engineers also interact with Customer Support on cases that need engineering input, and, for larger projects, join customer conversations to validate technical approaches.

**Continuous improvement and documentation

**We treat documentation, including API references, design decisions and runbooks, as part of delivering a change. Much of VMS's knowledge still sits with experienced team members, and capturing it in written, searchable form is an active priority. We also reserve time for technical debt and internal improvements.

**In your first 90 days, you can expect

**

• Month 1: Build your understanding of Sedna’s architecture and our products. Get set up with the VMS codebase, your dev environment and the release process, and ship your first changes. Meet your team, product manager and key customer-facing colleagues. Learn the maritime workflows our customers depend on.

• Month 2: Take ownership of a well-scoped piece of work from refinement with product through to release. Contribute to design discussions, give timely and constructive code review feedback. Shadow the on-call rotation and get familiar with runbooks and production tooling.

• Month 3: Lead the technical approach on a complex feature or improvement within your team, working independently and raising risks and dependencies early. Join the on-call rotation. Contribute improvements to tests, runbooks or documentation based on what you found hard to learn, and support technical validation in a customer conversation where relevant.

**What we're looking for:

****Essential experience

**Candidates typically bring three+ years of professional engineering experience from a comparable environment. Experience working on production systems where quality and reliability are important. Familiarity with a JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Scala) or a similar backend language, React or another modern frontend framework. Strong SQL and relational database skills, ideally Oracle or PostgreSQL, including query performance. Experience supporting production systems: diagnosing incidents from logs and metrics. Prior on-call experience is a plus.

**Critical skills

**A strong grasp of building and maintaining features within a larger system is helpful. Confidence with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and code review workflows is expected. Clear thinking, good problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work with domain-heavy logic contribute to success in the role. Experience with enterprise or workflow-driven applications is an advantage.

**Traits and mindset

**Curiosity and a willingness to learn the maritime domain are appreciated. A collaborative working style, comfort sharing ideas in cross-functional settings, and the ability to work independently when needed all support strong performance. Adaptability is important as the product and architecture continue to evolve.

**Core competencies

**Systems thinking, ownership of outcomes, strong communication skills, and effective collaboration are central to this role. A motivation to create value for customers and contribute to a stable, evolving platform is essential.

**What’s In Store for You

**

• A strong team. You’ll join a global team of senior and staff engineers who set a high bar and will help level you up.

• A generous salary and benefits package (depending on experience) + private medical, equity, health and wellbeing benefits, home internet contribution

• Scalability challenges. You’ll be a part of evolving our VMS system as we further develop in to a product led company.

• Customer impact. Real customers use our products everyday, you'll see your work impacting real people.

• Collaboration & autonomy. Plenty of heads-down technical work, but also close partnership with product engineers and engineering leadership.

**Our Values:

**Finally, culture is important to us, so we also look for candidates who share our values:

**Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

**

• We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.

• Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.

• We embrace challenges as opportunities and remain resilient under pressure.

• By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

**Execute With Focus

**

• We turn strategy into action, delivering measurable results that matter.

• Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.

• We make smart decisions with speed, balancing pace and precision.

• Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

**Work Together, Win Together

**

• Collaboration is our superpower-we succeed as one team, internally and with customers.

• We co-create solutions, seek feedback, and build the future of Sedna together.

• Strong relationships are built on trust, respect, and shared goals.

• By aligning across teams and with customers, we unlock greater impact.

jobs.description:
Are you a senior backend engineer who wants to combine hands-on development with technical leadership, cloud architecture and operational responsibility?

For our client Lattec, we are looking for a hands-on Backend Tech Lead / SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) to help shape, build and operate their AWS-based backend platform. This is a key technical role in Lattec’s R&D Software organisation, where you will provide day-to-day technical leadership within the backend/SRE domain while remaining close to the code, architecture and production systems.

Lattec, based in Allerød, Denmark, has achieved significant international success with its advanced solutions for modern dairy farming. The company develops proactive analytical and sensor systems that monitor the health of dairy cows on farms, serving customers worldwide. Lattec has a strong multidisciplinary team of approx. 60 employees, around 30 in R&D including software developers, hardware, electronics and mechanical engineers, as well as chemical engineers, veterinarians and biologists.

The role as Backend Tech Lead / SRE

In this role, you will take technical ownership of the backend/SRE domain and translate overall technical direction into daily engineering execution. You will guide backend developers, contribute directly to development and strengthen the reliability, observability and operational maturity of the platform.

Lattec’s Tech Leads collaborate closely across Device, Backend/SRE and Frontend, recognising cross-team collaboration as essential to sharing priorities, managing dependencies and aligning technical decisions. This ensures a common direction and helps identify integration risks early.

What you will do

• Lead the day-to-day technical work within the backend/SRE domain.

• Actively contribute to backend development and remain close to the code and technology.

• Provide technical direction, support architectural decisions and help resolve complex technical challenges.

• Take technical ownership of SRE, reliability, observability and operability.

• Improve monitoring, incident handling, CI/CD, automation and deployment practices.

• Drive good engineering practices, code quality, maintainability and documentation.

• Work with AWS-based backend technologies, focusing on scalable, secure and reliable solutions.

• Work closely with the R&D Software Lead to translate overall R&D priorities into clear backend/SRE priorities, ensuring that incoming tasks are understood, assessed and handled in line with the wider R&D direction.

Tech stack and your experience

We expect you to bring strong, hands-on experience with several of the core technologies used in the AWS backend platform, including:

• Python for backend services, automation, data processing and AWS Lambda development.

• TypeScript for modern backend services, tooling, infrastructure definitions and integrations where relevant.

• AWS Lambda and serverless architecture, including event-driven design, scalability, security and operational robustness.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC), such as AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform or similar tools, to ensure repeatable and maintainable cloud infrastructure.

• GraphQL for new APIs, including schema design, resolver implementation, API versioning, performance considerations and alignment with frontend consumers.

• AWS services commonly used in backend platforms, such as API Gateway, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, CloudWatch and IAM.

• CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation and production monitoring in an AWS environment.

About you

You are a senior backend engineer who enjoys combining hands-on development with technical leadership. You are comfortable making technical decisions, guiding other developers and taking responsibility for systems that need to run reliably in production.

You likely bring:

• Strong backend engineering experience, preferably in cloud-native or serverless environments.

• A practical understanding of SRE, observability and operating production systems.

• Experience designing APIs and integrations, ideally using GraphQL.

• A pragmatic approach to guiding technical decisions, fostering open collaboration and keeping momentum high.

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to work across frontend, backend and device boundaries.

• A focus on quality, security and maintainable solutions.

Fluency in English and Danish is essential.

What makes this role different

This is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position. You lead through technical expertise, collaboration and active involvement in development, staying close to the code while providing the direction needed to ensure the backend/SRE domain evolves in line with the wider platform.

The Lattec mindset

• Be curious, experiment and take pride in making things work better.

• Ask “What is the system actually doing?” — not just “Is this a software problem?”

• Work across disciplines and take responsibility for the whole solution.

• Deliver precise data that helps farmers make better decisions.

• Build reliable systems that reduce downtime and give peace of mind.

• Make advanced technology simple, so customers get the value without the hassle.

Why join Lattec?

At Lattec, you will work on technology that supports modern dairy farming and contributes to better animal welfare through advanced digital solutions. You will join a focused engineering environment where backend, frontend and device development work closely together to create robust and scalable products.

Product development at Lattec is a shared, creative journey where Product Managers, R&D specialists and engineers combine domain knowledge and technical expertise to create real value for farmers.

Lattec offers a high degree of flexibility and excellent employee benefits, including five weeks of annual holiday, five additional days off, four extra Lattec days off, a pension scheme, health insurance and a lunch scheme with themed lunch days.

More about the company

Lattec I/S was founded in 2001 and employs approx. 60 people in Allerød, with a few additional employees based in Fredericia. The company is owned by the Swedish company DeLaval, which has more than 4,500 employees worldwide.

You will become part of a company with dedicated employees, a flat organisational structure and an informal working environment, where teamwork, collaboration and professional excellence are highly valued.

Read more at www.lattec.com.

Are you interested in joining Lattec?

Please do not hesitate to apply by sending your CV and a short application. If you have any questions, you are most welcome to contact Director Sara Juhl at Bloom via sj@bloom.dk or phone +45 20 86 08 65.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Are you passionate about leading IT compliance in a modern, regulated environment?

Do you combine deep knowledge of GxP, SOX, validation, and emerging regulatory frameworks with the ability to set direction, help people grow, and enable pragmatic delivery?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Head of IT Compliance.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking an experienced and people-focused Head of IT Compliance to lead our IT Compliance competency team and shape how compliance enables innovation and delivery across Global IT. You will set direction for the area, guide a team of trusted compliance specialists, and partner closely with IT product and platform teams to translate regulatory requirements into practical, risk-based ways of working.

As Head of IT Compliance at Ascendis Pharma, you will combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution. You will lead and develop the team while also working alongside them, shaping the direction of the function while actively contributing to its delivery and success.

At Ascendis Pharma, we take a modern approach to IT compliance. Our ambition is to enable continuous compliance through modern IT tools, shift-left testing principles, and agile ways of working. As a leader and senior role model, you will champion critical thinking and a strong quality mindset, challenge unnecessary complexity, and create clarity and confidence for both your team and stakeholders.

You will join Global IT and report directly to Henrik Aagaard Linnemann, Global Head of Digitalization. You will be based at our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Lead and further develop the IT Compliance function, including setting direction, developing team capabilities, and fostering a culture of quality, learning, and critical thinking.

• Partner with IT Product and Platform teams operating in GxP-regulated environments to enable compliant, efficient, and business-focused delivery.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders and stakeholders on IT compliance, quality management, computer system validation, testing, and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Drive the continuous evolution of the IT Quality Management System (IT QMS), governance frameworks, and related compliance processes, including SOX controls.

• Monitor and assess emerging regulatory requirements, ensuring that relevant changes are reflected in IT policies, standards, procedures, and ways of working.

• Promote modern compliance practices by advancing continuous compliance principles, shift-left testing approaches, and agile methodologies across Global IT.

• Build compliance capabilities across the organization through training, coaching, knowledge sharing, and awareness initiatives

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a relevant academic degree and bring extensive experience from regulated pharmaceutical or life-science environments, ideally including 10+ years within IT compliance, quality, validation, or related disciplines.

You have leadership experience and can combine strategic direction with practical support to teams and stakeholders.

Furthermore, you have:

• Strong experience with GxP, pharmaceutical IT compliance, computer system validation, validation planning, testing, test execution, and quality assurance

• Solid knowledge of SOX controls and regulatory frameworks such as 21 CFR Part 11, EudraLex Volume 4 Annex 11, GAMP 5, the EU AI Act, NIS2, and European data privacy regulations

• A strong technical understanding and the ability to translate complex regulatory expectations into clear, practical guidance for highly skilled IT professionals

• Experience supporting agile product and platform teams while maintaining appropriate regulatory oversight and a risk-based approach

• Experience developing people through leadership, coaching, training, and knowledge sharing, and the ability to build trusted relationships across functions and geographies

Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

To succeed in this role, we expect you to be pragmatic, collaborative, and self-driven. You are capable of managing priorities independently, build trusted relationships across stakeholders, and enjoy coaching and developing colleagues through knowledge sharing and guidance.
